definitions: exact top-r support family under a boundary tie
identified iff F is constant on the admissible family
theorem_targets: T1: admissible supports are exactly fixed-above elements union a k-subset of the boundary tie block
T2: F is identified iff min F over admissible supports equals max F
T3: if F is not constant, there exists a witness pair of admissible supports differing by one exchange in the tie block on which F differs
T4: that adjacent witness pair is a sufficient exact certificate of non-identifiability
proof_plan: Use connectivity of the Johnson graph on k-subsets for T3; verify finite controls with a checker written from the theorem statement rather than the ORION-21 runner.
old_data_rule: Existing tie-robust transcripts may be used only after the theorem is fixed as labelled examples/counterexample search; they cannot promote the old phase law.
